requirements.name: A1.1 — Claims, attribution and evidence limits
requirements.weight: Formative practice — no course-grade weight specified
requirements.description: Make a three-row claim table (equivalent labeled prose is welcome). For each selected statement, identify its speaker or document, quote it, classify its role as a reported observation, attributed assertion or explanation, and quote the stated basis or limit. Explain what the explanation does and does not establish, including why missing evidence proves neither it nor its opposite. Propose one specific evidence check and explain what it could resolve and what would remain unknown. Submit: One three-row claim-and-basis table plus a bounded conclusion and one proposed evidence check; labeled prose is equally acceptable. Success criteria: Identify and attribute evidence; Explain the reasoning and complete the task; State what the evidence leaves unresolved.
